chunks.text: This country is called Bulgaria.
It is a country with mountains, beaches, rivers, forests, villages, and cities.
It has friendly people, delicious food, and old traditions.
I will speak slowly and clearly.
Listen carefully and try to understand.
Where is Bulgaria?
Bulgaria is in Southeast Europe, in a region called the Balkans.
It shares borders with Romania to the north, Serbia and North Macedonia to the west, Greece and Turkey to the south, and the Black Sea to the east.
The Black Sea is very important because it gives Bulgaria beautiful beaches.
The capital city of Bulgaria is Sofia.
Sofia is in the west of the country.
It is a modern city, but it also has old buildings and churches.
Many people live and work in Sofia.
The city has museums, shops, schools, parks, and theaters.
One famous place in Sofia is the Alexander Nevsky Cathedral, a big church with golden domes.
Other big cities in Bulgaria are Plovdiv, Varna, Bergus, and Rus.
Plovdiv is one of the oldest cities in Europe.
Varna and Bergus are near the sea and are great for summer holidays.
What is Bulgaria famous for?
Bulgaria is famous for many things.
One of them is its history.
People have lived in Bulgaria for thousands of years.
There are old castles, Roman theaters, and churches.
You can see ruins and learn about the past.
Bulgaria is also famous for its nature.
It has mountains like Rila, Pirin, and Roadope.
People go hiking and skiing there.
In winter, the mountains are full of snow.
In summer, they are green and peaceful.
The Black Sea Coast is another special part of Bulgaria.
People go there in summer to swim, sunbathe, and eat seafood.
Some popular places on the coast are Sunny Beach, Golden Sands, and Sozopol.
Bulgaria is also famous for its rose oil.
In the Rose Valley, people grow many roses.
They use the petals to make rose water and oil, which is used in perfumes.
Every year, there is a rose festival in the town of Kazanlak.
What is the food like in Bulgaria?
Bulgarian food is fresh, simple, and very tasty.
People eat a lot of vegetables, cheese, bread, yogurt, and meat.
Here are some popular foods.
Shopska salad.
A cold salad with tomatoes, cucumbers, onions, peppers, and white cheese on top.
It is fresh and colorful.
Bonita, a pastry made with eggs and cheese.
People eat it for breakfast or with yogurt.
Kibapche, grilled meat shaped like small sausages, often served with French fries or bread.
Tarator, a cold soup made with yogurt, cucumber, garlic, and dill.
People eat it in summer.
Musaka, a dish with potatoes, minced meat, and eggs.
It is baked in the oven.
Bulgarians also love yogurt.
Bulgarian yogurt is very special.
It has a healthy bacteria called lactobacillus bulgaricus.
People eat it plain with honey or with fruits.
They also drink aran, which is a salty yogurt drink.
For dessert, people enjoy baklava, ravini, a sweet cake with syrup, or lokum, Turkish delight.
Culture and people.
People in Bulgaria are kind, helpful, and family oriented.
Family is very important.
People spend time together at home, in the park, or on trips.
Many families grow their own vegetables and gardens.
The main language in Bulgaria is Bulgarian, and it uses the Cyrillic alphabet, like Russian.
For example, hello in Bulgarian is zdrave, zdrave.
Many young people learn English at school.
Most people in Bulgaria are Eastern Orthodox Christians.
There are many beautiful churches and monasteries.
People go to church on special days like Easter and Christmas.
Bulgaria has many traditions and folklore.
People wear colorful costumes, sing folk songs, and dance in circles.
This dance is called the horror.
People dance the horror at weddings, festivals, and public holidays.
Special celebrations.
Bulgaria has many interesting holidays.
Here are a few.
Baba Marta Day, March 1st.
People give red and white bracelets called martinichki for health and happiness.
They wear them until they see a stork or tree blooming in spring.
Easter, people paint eggs and eat a special bread called Kozunak.
St.
George's Day, May 6th.
A holiday for bravery and farmers.
People often eat lamb on this day.
Christmas, December 25th.
Families come together to eat, sing songs, and exchange gifts.
Nature and animals.
Bulgaria has beautiful forests, mountains, lakes, and rivers.
Many people enjoy nature activities like hiking, camping, skiing, and fishing.
You can see animals like bears, wolves, foxes, deer, and wild boars.
The Stara Planina Mountains and Rila National Park are good places to see wildlife.
The Black Sea is great for swimming and relaxing.
In summer, the weather is warm and sunny.
In winter, the mountains are cold and snowy.
Conclusion, Bulgaria is a beautiful and peaceful country.
It has big cities, small villages, mountains, and beaches.
It has tasty food, friendly people, and a lot of history.
Would you like to visit Bulgaria one day?
I hope you enjoyed learning about this special country.
Thank you for listening to Slow English Podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
